mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('content:', c.content_id) AS docId, 'POST' AS docKind, c.content_id AS contentId, NULL AS answerId, IFNULL(c.title, '') AS title, IFNULL(c.content, '') AS content, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(c.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime, DATE_FORMAT(c.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN c.is_deleted = 1 THEN 'deleted' ELSE 'active' END AS status FROM tb_content c WHERE (c.audit_status = 1 OR c.is_deleted = 1) AND c.update_time >= #{since} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('answer:', a.answer_id) AS docId, 'ANSWER' AS docKind, a.question_id AS contentId, a.answer_id AS answerId, IFNULL(question.title, '') AS title, IFNULL(a.content, '') AS content, DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime, DATE_FORMAT(a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN a.is_deleted = 1 THEN 'deleted' ELSE 'active' END AS status FROM tb_question_answer a LEFT JOIN tb_content question ON question.content_id = a.question_id WHERE (a.audit_status = 1 OR a.is_deleted = 1) AND a.update_time >= #{since} UNION ALL SELECT policy.doc_id AS docId, 'POLICY' AS docKind, NULL AS contentId, NULL AS answerId, IFNULL(policy.title, '') AS title, IFNULL(policy.content, '') AS content, DATE_FORMAT(policy.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(policy.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime, DATE_FORMAT(policy.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN policy.is_deleted = 1 THEN 'deleted' ELSE 'active' END AS status FROM tb_bot_policy_doc policy WHERE policy.update_time >= #{since} ) sync_rows ORDER BY sync_rows.updateTime, sync_rows.docId LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
